info.name: Kong Enterprise Admin ACLs API Attributes API

params.name: page[size]
params.description: The maximum number of items to include per page. The last page of a collection may include fewer items.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Determines which page of the entities to retrieve.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters API attributes in the response.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorts a collection of API attributes. Supported sort attributes are:
  - id
  - key
  - created_at
  - updated_at
